title: Pop-up Banner
slide_intent: Teach designers to compose a tall event surface for recognition at a distance. A stable signature position lets the large image field carry different people and messages.
strategic_value: CSAIL can use the same portable banner format for different events. A constant mark and web address identify the lab while portraits bring attention to its members and research.
demonstration: Two retractable banners appear side by side against gray. Both carry a large mark above angular tinted photographs and a web address below. The left runs a phrase across the portraits. The right places a phrase beneath the mark.
practical_value: Compare the two placements when choosing where a short message belongs. Check whether it reads more clearly across a photograph or in the white space beneath the signature.

content_islands.name: Banner guidance
content_islands.spec: Set the title and a short explanation in the upper-left column. Keep the event use and contact instructions together.

content_islands.name: Standing banner pair
content_islands.spec: Show the two retractable stands at equal height on a common gray field. Keep the white top and bottom zones, signature and website position consistent. Vary the central portrait sequence, tint and phrase placement.

content_islands.name: Book footer
content_islands.spec: Align the short-guide identifier, laboratory name and folio along the bottom margin.
